religion.definition: Deity invoked by Elara; appears in oaths and exclamations.

politics.definition: Inherited political status associated with a ruling bloodline.
Royal/Spire-controlled region associated with House Valerius.

energy.definition: Magical energy used throughout Aethelgard's industrial and technological systems.

technology.definition: Technology that conducts or manipulates magical currents.
Industrial filtration infrastructure associated with Flux extraction.

infrastructure.definition: Large-scale arrays associated with stabilizing magical and reality currents.
Living magical current carried through ancient roots.

factions.definition: Nickname for the feared Elven faction. It does not refer to the sky-fissure creatures.
Military organization associated with Kaelen's background.
Vertical imperial power structure associated with House Valerius.

world_events.definition: A dangerous tear in reality spreading across the sky beyond the protected basin.
The visible rupture in reality from which hostile creatures emerge.
